issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #0
issues.synopsis: While Robin and Nightwing stake out some safe-crackers, they discuss what led each of them to become Batman's crimefighting partner. Nightwing also reveals a particularly unpleasant episode from his time as Robin: Two-Face had set up a double gallows trap, to hang either Batman or Gotham's new district attorney. Dick tried to double-blood Two-Face but failed, leading to the death of the D.A.. Both he and Two-Face still remember this incident clearly, though Batman has never mentioned it to the current Robin. Returning to the Batcave, they meet Batman, who says he needs a rest, but this time will hand the mantle on to someone it always should have gone to: Nightwing.

Supporting Characters: Nightwing (First appearance as Batman) (Flashback and main story)

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #1
issues.synopsis:
Robin takes the Redbird for a ride

Robin finds himself with his throat in the vice-like grip of the new Batman, Jean-Paul Valley . Robin fears for his life, wondering at the fact that his death could come at the hands of the man hand-picked to replace his mentor, Bruce Wayne . Desperately, he jabs one of his R-shaped shuriken into Jean-Paul's arm, and the shock causes his adversary to release him. Strangely, Jean-Paul seems to come out of a trance, claiming that he had been under control of The System , a prospect which doesn't encourage Robin with respect to the new Batman's reliability or sanity. Rather than stick around, Robin hops into the Redbird and escapes from the Batcave .

Meanwhile, a gang called the Speedboyz attempts to boost cars from the Gotham Heights Country Club parking lot. When the security guards intervene, the gang members open fire with automatic weapons, and speed away in their stolen cars.

Robin ditches the Redbird in the old carriage house at Drake Manor , and then tries to get on with his normal life as Tim Drake. On the bus to school, Tim has to turn down his friend Ives on an invite to the movies, because he has plans to go to a mixer with Ariana in Gotham Heights. His relationship with Ariana is a positive force in his life that makes him forget about all of the horrors of the last month in his other life.

However, at the mixer, he and Ariana are accosted by the jock Karl Ranck , who invites them to a party at his house. When Ariana responds that they don't have a car, Karl makes fun of Tim for it, and Tim consequently blames Ariana. Before he can apologize, the dance is interrupted by the carjacking Speedboyz. Tim notices that Karl is trying to prevent his car from being stolen, and winds up with a gun in his face. Tim's quick thinking saves Karl's life, and his heroics make Ariana forget about his earlier rudeness.

Shotgun confronts a "Speedboy"

Elsewhere, Arthur Brown and some other criminals incarcerated at Blackgate Penitentiary attend a group therapy session where they eventually overpower their psychologist and give him some special instructions.

Robin speeds off in the Redbird in search of the Speedboyz, hoping to put a stop to their thefts. But when he realizes that someone is tailgating him, he tries to shake off his pursuer, and winds up crashed into some trees. He soon finds himself at the wrong end of Sheriff Smith's shotgun, suspected of being a Speedboy himself.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #2
issues.synopsis:
With Shotgun Smith 's weapon pointed at him, Robin is forced to prove that he is not one of the Speedboyz . He tries honesty, explaining that he is Batman 's sidekick, and that he was himself after the Speedboyz when Smith pulled him over. Shotgun Smith seems particularly uninformed, and doubts Robin's story, forcing the boy wonder to throw a tear-gas bomb, and escape in the Redbird . As he drives away, he silently curses the mask he wears and all of the limitations it puts on him.

Meanwhile, a group of convicts including Cluemaster , Czonk , Cypher , and Electrocutioner are visited at Blackgate Penitentiary by their therapist Dr. Simpson. Simpson is affected by mind control, and smuggles weapons to them. They then make their getaway, leaving Dr. Simpson in their cell.

Later, Tim calls his girlfriend Ariana , and it becomes clear that she is getting frustrated with his apparent preoccupations. After a brief conversation, Tim has to hang up to take a call from Alfred . Alfred reveals that he and Bruce are in England , and close to tracking down Tim's kidnapped father Jack . Before hanging up, Tim blurts out that he has concerns about Jean-Paul Valley 's approach to being the new Batman of Gotham City .

As the Cluemaster and company sneak through the sewers at Blackgate, Cypher makes an attempt to take control of them by using his powers of hypnosis. However, the Cluemaster turns and shoots him dead, having prepared for that eventuality by equipping himself and his compatriots with cotton to block their ears.

After fruitlessly driving around hoping to run into the Speedboyz, Robin returns home to think out the case further. He concludes that the Speedboys must have a chop-shop for the stolen cars' parts close to the pier for easy smuggling. He concludes that they might be using an abandoned oil terminal nearby. When he arrives, his suspicions are confirmed, and he sneaks into a high window. However, while he's inside, one of the Speedboyz happens upon the parked Redbird, and winds up getting electrocuted by it. His friends come rushing out, and they all try to get inside the car, while Robin - highly amused - controls the car by remote.

After getting the car to safety, Robin sneaks in and accesses their computers. While he's at it, one of the Speedboyz' biggest thugs, Cassidy , grabs him from behind. After much struggle and evasion on Robin's part, he remembers that he controls the Redbird, and sends it careening into the thug, burying him under a pile of tires. Unfortunately, the other Speedboyz return moments later, and he is forced to take them all down before they can fire their guns. With the thugs taken out, he heads home, hoping to get some sleep.

Shotgun Smith and the Gotham County Sheriff's department arrive and arrest the Speedboyz. When Smith demands to know who tipped them off, he is informed that "a little bird" told them.

Elsewhere, Detectives Bullock and Montoya investigate the Cluemaster's escape from Blackgate. Despite Warden Grimes' reassurances that they likely drowned in the process of swimming across the river, both detectives are convinced that the Cluemaster is back, with plans to kill them.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #3
issues.synopsis: Robin tackles the usual holiday-season crime, yet finds it difficult to keep his two lives separate, to the point where Ariana wonders whether he's seeing someone else. He has learned that Cluemaster, Electrocutioner and Czonk have escaped from Blackgate and decides to investigate, inevitably running into Spoiler.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #4
issues.synopsis: Robin and Spoiler get on the trail of Cluemaster, Czonk and Electrocutioner, as do the cops. Robin soon figures out that a clue sent by Czonk to the police for no apparent reason is indicating the theft of worn-out currency, so he interrupts the robbery. However, he and Cluemaster become trapped in the back of the armored van containing the loot, and the van itself is soon buried in concrete, where no one will think to look for it.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #5
issues.synopsis: Robin and Cluemaster are trapped in the back of an armored van which is buried in concrete, and have a very limited supply of air. Luckily for them, once the other villains realize that the police and Spoiler are on their tail, they return to get the cash and run. Spoiler is rather surprised to see Robin emerge from the van once she knocks out the Electrocutioner; it soon becomes apparent that she has developed a crush on Robin.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #6

info.Editors: Neal Pozner Jordan B. Gorfinkel Dennis O'Neil

issues.synopsis: Having come to the Huntress' aid in her skirmish with Mickey Silver and a group of motorcycling hoods, Robin works with her on the twin cases of Mandy Paoulo and Silver. They learn that Mandy wanted Mickey dead, then encounter another masked person, the gun-toting Deathangel. Later, Robin follows Mandy's trail back to St. Anscom's church and to the office of her brother, Father Daniel Paolo, where he is met by Deathangel...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #7

info.Cover Artists: Tom Grummett Ray Kryssing Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis:
Jack Drake is en route home and Tim is delighted. As he and Bruce wait for Jack at the airport, they discuss their future plans and Tim is less than pleased to learn that Bruce is considering not coming out of his retirement from his role as Batman. However, every shadow of doubt is gone once Jack is safely home. Bruce takes the Drakes on a ride back to Drake Manor , where Tim learns that his father is determined to spend more time with him, which could only complicate his secret life as Robin.

Bruce Wayne confronts Azrael

After this, Tim has the harsh duty to reveal the current state of affairs with Jean-Paul and his role as Batman. For this purpose, Tim goes with Bruce to Wayne Manor , where Bruce is shocked to learn the truth. His ancestral home has been abandoned by the man he chose as his replacement and Tim breaks the news about Abattoir 's death at the hands of Jean-Paul. Furious and disturbed with the madman's actions, Bruce goes into Wayne Manor and breaks the brick wall that was built to seal the secret entrance to the Batcave . Bruce and Robin go downstairs to confront Jean-Paul, who returns to the place after his alarms had been activated. Bruce is disgusted looking at Jean-Paul and tries to take the mantle of the bat away from the madman. Jean-Paul however is convinced that he is the rightful and only Batman and he manages to overcome Bruce without much effort. Jean-Paul leaves in the Batmobile , giving Bruce a final warning to never return. Robin becomes infuriated and soon takes the Redbird to follow Jean-Paul down the highway.

The Redbird is no match for the Batmobile and soon, Robin has to admit defeat and gives up the chase. Upon returning to the secret barn, Robin talks with Bruce, who has come to terms with the fact that he needs to become Batman to save Gotham from the deranged Jean-Paul. However, Bruce is aware that his physical condition is nowhere near that of his former self and he decides to train with the most prolific and dangerous combat master he knows. With this resolution, Robin finds peace knowing that the rightful Batman will claim his place in Gotham.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #8

info.Cover Artists: Tom Grummett Ray Kryssing Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis:
Bruce Wayne has delivered the fatal Leopard Blow to his final opponent just as Robin and Nightwing witness the scene. They are both appalled, whereas Lady Shiva , who also witnessed the scene, is delighted and pleased to have tainted the name of the Dark Knight. Shiva takes the Mask of Tengu , but not all is not as it seems as the man starts recovering and Bruce explains that this was all a ruse to satisfy Shiva. After the situation is cleared, Bruce decides it's time to set things right.

Meanwhile, on his quest to find LeHah, Batman has gone on a rampage against some members of the Gotham Organized Crime , creating troubles for the corrupt businessman Penn Selkirk who has come to the conclusion that Batman has to be dealt with. As this happens, Shiva confronts the ninjas wearing the Mask of Tengu and informs them that their quest is over, beating them all.

Batman is Back

With all the circumstances and events happening in Gotham, the Gotham City Police Department find themselves at a loss and even Commissioner Gordon has begun to lose hope. When night comes, Nightwing and Robin start preparing the Batcave as Bruce decides to finally return. At that same moment in Blackgate Penitentiary , the special area for the inmates from Arkham Asylum have become unusually active and Bane finally recovers from his catatonic state in time to realize that Batman is back.

Nightwing and Robin are much satisfied to see the real Batman back in action, but the Dark Knight knows that the fight for Gotham is just about to begin.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #9

info.Cover Artists: Tom Grummett Ray Kryssing Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis:
Robin tentatively returns to the Batcave , not sure what he'll find there. He is relieved to discover Bruce Wayne there after Jean-Paul has left for good. Bruce tells Robin that he plans to make a few changes, but he leaves before making it clear what changes he would make.

Tim returns home, hoping to catch some sleep, but as soon as he goes to bed, he is called by his father as they are going to buy a new family car. After they settle for a van that would help Jack take his wheelchair, the Drakes return home and Tim tries to sleep a little bit, when Ariana call him over the phone and arranges a meeting.

Going on the new van, Tim and Ari get to talk after a long time and she decides to tell Tim the truth about her mistake with one of their classmates, but Tim can't help it and falls asleep in the middle of her heartfelt confession. Tim is only awoken by the slamming of the van's door as Ari had left in anger.

Tim gets home late and all he wants is to sleep the night. Unfortunately, the Bat-Signal shines in the sky and Tim goes into action as Robin. When he doesn't find Bruce in the Batcave, he takes the Redbird and goes to the Gotham Museum of Antiquities , where the Gotham City Police Department have surrounded the building in order to capture the thugs inside.

Robin sneaks into the building unnoticed and he comes across one of the thugs. Taking the man down, Tim learns the location of the rest of criminals and he goes to the place to keep a close eye on them. Robin is only waiting for Batman to make his move, but in the meantime, he falls asleep and misses Batman's first move. When he wakes up, Robin watches as Batman takes down most of the thugs and he jumps into action, saving Batman from an sneaky attack. After capturing the thugs, Batman tells Robin that he can keep the job if he so desires and the Dynamic Duo move out of the place, allowing the police to do their work.

When the police learn that the place has been cleared, Commissioner Gordon is glad to have repaired the Bat-Signal , but he is still unsure about the future with Batman.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #10
issues.synopsis: Robin is pursuing a jewel thief who is known as the Weasel due to his talent for making a getaway. He is rather surprised to find himself assisted by... Robin, as in Dick Grayson, brought to the present either from the past or an alternate timeline. The two Robins work together, chasing the Weasel through Gotham Aquarium and having a close encounter with sharks and a killer whale. They then see him fall into a tank of piranha and call the police to get his skeleton out. The current Robin then has a flash of brilliance and the two of them head back inside, finding the crook - wringing wet - hiding in a cupboard. He had evidently planned his escape route long ago, as the tank he 'accidentally' fell into contains a species of piranha which does not indulge in eating flesh. However, as they hand him over to the police, first Dick and then everything else fades from existence...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #11

info.Cover Artists: Tom Grummett Ray Kryssing Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis: Robin tries to sort his personal life out - spending time with his dad and patching things up with Ariana. Meanwhile, Two-Face gets started on his plan to foul up Gotham's justice system, starting by killing a group of lawyers, then taking a chainsaw to the databanks which hold criminals records and the like. While doing this, he is met by Batman and Robin...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #12
issues.synopsis: Tim Drake falls afoul of a couple of bullies and, so as not to give away his secret identity as Robin, must allow himself to be beaten up in front of Ariana. Beating criminals as Robin doesn't make things any better, but before long he re-encounters them alone and pays them back in kind. He then makes his way to see Ariana, but finds her in tears - her uncle is being threatened by the Russian mob.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #13
issues.synopsis: Robin fights Steeljacket, once he can get close enough that is, being dragged across the Gotham skyline for a time first. Meanwhile, Dick Grayson and Bruce Wayne have the conversation they should have had long ago, working out where they really stand with one another: as father and son. Bruce Wayne is now ready to take back the role of Batman, and he now knows that Dick will stand by his side as Nightwing just as much as Tim will as Robin.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #14
issues.synopsis: Robin finds himself facing KGBeast in the midst of a blazing chemicals plant. He has shot Harvey Bullock, but Robin gets some help from new detective Mackenzie Bock. Batman is elsewhere, battling Romana, though he soon realizes that she has no idea where the nuclear device is. Robin holds his own against the KGBeast, but eventually his foe decides to throw the baseball-shaped device, and it looks like Robin isn't going to make the catch. Luckily, Batman has just arrived on the scene, and does make the catch - Gotham is saved. Bullock is in a coma, but it looks like he should pull through. Meanwhile, out on Blackgate Island, the Cluemaster is planning something, something involving Robin...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #15

info.Inkers: Frank McLaughlin Dick Giordano Scott Hanna

issues.synopsis: Robin foils a gang of thieves who have been stealing entire ATM machines with the aid of a fork-lift truck, and later works with Batman, on a tip-off from the Cluemaster to find sophisticated robber Gully Carson. The robbers have Stephanie Brown hostage, and once they realize that Cluemaster has tipped off the police, they plan to kill her.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #16

info.Cover Artists: Tom Grummett Ray Kryssing Bob LeRose
info.Inkers: Frank McLaughlin Bob Smith John Stanisci

issues.synopsis: Robin helps Stephanie escape from Gully Carson's gang, and she then insists on helping him (as Spoiler) to bring them in. Once they have done so, she pays her father a visit on Blackgate Island. Her 'abduction' by Carson was largely his idea, and she shows him exactly how she feels about it.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #17
issues.story: "War of the Dragons, Part Two: The Silk Dragons"
issues.synopsis: As the gangs of Gotham's Chinatown continue their war, Robin fears he may have lost Ariana. When he and Batman arrive on the scene of a fight amongst King Snake, Lynx and the Ghost Dragons, Robin encounters Huntress and Batman tangles with the Silver Monkey.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #18
issues.synopsis: Someone is highlighting engineering problems in Gotham in a potentially lethal manner, causing walkways to collapse and other city structures to fail. Following leads from dismissed city employee Schuyler Ollsworthy, Robin tracks down the culprit - who is dressed as a mouse - to City Hall, and saves the mayor from death in a faulty lift. The culprit is revealed to be a woman named Pamela who was hopelessly in love with Mr Ollsworthy, although he had never noticed. Ollsworthy himself is re-hired by the mayor himself with carte blanche to ensure that the city's engineering problems are fixed.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #19
issues.synopsis: Robin investigates some odd historically-themed thefts while, as Tim, he begins to repair his relationship with Ariana. The General has been released from jail and teams up with a man who believes himself to be Caesar. Robin tracks them to the General's basement, and soon finds himself quite literally thrown to the (circus) lion.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #20
issues.synopsis: Robin calms the lion and is rescued by the General's siblings, who aren't at all fond of their brother. He and Sherrif Smith then pursue the General as he leads Los Bandidos against the Vandals gang. The General is brought in, but Julius Caesar escapes, back to his leader, Maxie Zeus. Tim then returns home to discover Ariana in his bedroom - she's run away from home...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #21
issues.synopsis: Tim Drake has some explaining to do when Mrs McIlvaine discovers Ariana in his bed - but as he slept in the spare room, and Dana is in the house, it's his father who ends up blushing... Robin later gets on the trail of a gang of ninja kid thieves, and surmising that they are being trained and recruited at a ninja camp, he gets himself sent off there.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #22
issues.synopsis: At the ninja training camp, Robin (disguised as 'Alvin Draper') uncovers the evidence of the sensei's illegal activities that he needs. When Jack and Dana come to pick him up they have some bad news - Ariana and her family are leaving Gotham.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #23
issues.synopsis: Neron strikes a bargain with Killer Moth which transforms the criminal into a monstrous moth-like creature, allowing him to promptly escape from Arkham. Tim Drake is delighted to learn that his girlfriend Ariana is not leaving Gotham as he had feared - in fact, she's moving closer to him and will now be attending his school. Later, as Robin, he hears of Killer Moth's escape and pursues, soon finding himself as a prisoner of the monster.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #24
issues.synopsis: It looks very much as though Robin is going to be the feature on Charaxes' menu, as Sheriff Smith and his crew are not able to hold the monster back from his feed. Batman is on his way, but the bug is captured by a mysterious newcomer before he arrives on the scene. Back at school the next day, Tim is approached by Karl Ranck, who believes they should solve the school's problems - by carrying guns.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #25
issues.synopsis: Tim Drake becomes acutely aware of a gun problem in his school and tries to solve it in both his civilian guise and as Robin. He, Spoiler and Green Arrow take down some gun runners, and as Tim Drake he informs the principal of the situation, but he is too late. Before long, Karl Ranck is dead, killed by a bullet from Young El's gun in a pointless gunfight.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #26
issues.synopsis: Following the death of Karl Ranck, Robin and Spoiler - first separately, then together - try to track down his killer, Young El. They trace his location and soon find themselves in hot water in the midst of a gun battle, from which they have to be rescued by Batman. Robin is reminded that the justice he seeks is for everyone in Gotham, not just those he happens to know, but the death of Karl will leave its mark on him for some time to come.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #27
issues.story: " Contagion , Part Three: Natural Born Healer"

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Bob LeRose Heroic Age

issues.synopsis: Robin clashes with Catwoman, both of them looking for plague survivor Kendall Stuart, though for very different reasons. He soon realizes that the most efficient way of finding Stuart will be to work together with Catwoman, a measure Alfred is somewhat dubious about. Meanwhile, the Clench continues to claim many victims, including the Palmoy family, and one of the most recently infected is Montoya's boyfriend Johnny. Panic sets in as news of the plague is broadcast and exit and entrance to Gotham forbidden. Robin and Catwoman track down Kendall Stuart, but so does mercenary Tracker, who attack them, intending to take Stuart himself. Azrael, sent by Batman, also arrives on the scene.

Other Characters: Kip Palmoy (Appears only as a corpse)

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #28

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis: Nightwing races to the Batcave with the cure for the Clench, but Alfred tells him that it is too late for Robin. However, when he sees Batman and a cured Tim, Nightwing realizes Alfred was only bluffing. Meanwhile, the state governor has sworn in newly-elected mayor Marion Grange ahead of schedule, and she has reinstated James Gordon as police commissioner. Robin heads back home, taking a detour to deal with gang who refuse to let the cure into their area, teaming up once more with Catwoman. When he returns home, his family are relieved to see him again, as is Ariana, whom Tim is particularly surprised to see.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #29
issues.synopsis: Tim Drake is extremely surprised to discover that Ariana has bleached her hair blonde, done because she saw him look at Stephanie Brown (Spoiler) at Karl Ranck's funeral. He tries to tell her that he loves her as she is, but she doesn't listen. As Robin, he interrupts Maxie Zeus in the act of stealing an empty truck and is knocked unconscious by Maxie's strongman Heracles. When he comes to, Maxie demands that Robin arrange an audience with the Oracle for him.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #30
issues.synopsis: At the behest of Maxie Zeus, Robin contacts Oracle and keeps her talking long enough for her to trace the phone number. When one of Maxie's henchmen questions the sense of this measure, he has him killed. Meanwhile, Ariana finds that her new look leads a guy from school to force himself on her. With the help of a security guard, Robin stays out of Maxie's way until the police arrive. Later, when he sees Ariana, she has returned her hair to its normal color and is pleased to learn that Tim prefers it that way.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #31

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Tasty Fried Color

issues.synopsis: Tim and Ariana visit a car show, but both are distracted: Ariana by the sight of Jake Angstrom, who had tried to force himself on her, and Tim by the sight of the Speedboyz, a gang of carjackers. When Tim returns later as Robin, he encounters Wildcat, and works with him to ensure that the Speedboyz do not get away with any of the prize cars from the show. He then heads to the Batcave, where Batman has received some very bad news.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #32
issues.story: " Legacy , Part Three: Born With Teeth"

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis: In Paris, Robin and Nightwing track down the agents of Ra's al Ghul who plan to release the deadly Ebola Gulf A virus there. Batman advises Robin to seek out the assistance of Henri Ducard, and in time the location for the release is tracked down to the Louvre. After a violent confrontation with al Ghul's followers, the virus is found and prevented from being released. Robin and Nightwing then head back to Gotham on Batman's orders.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #33

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Bob LeRose Tasty Fried Color

issues.synopsis: Robin, Nightwing and Huntress board Ra's al Ghul's ship, the Shrike. Huntress and Nightwing keep Ra's, Talia and their followers occupied, while Robin establishes a connection from al Ghul's computer to Oracle, so that she can access the data which will allow a cure for the Clench to be found. With the help of major mainframes across the country, she is able to find the information she needs, and the heroes escape the ship shortly before it explodes. Later, the bodies of numerous mobsters drift in on the tide, carried there from Blüdhaven.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #34

info.Cover Artists: Mike Wieringo Terry Austin Bob LeRose Tasty Fried Color

issues.synopsis:
Tim , Ari , Ives and Callie attend a Shakespeare play entitled Macbeth on the beach , at Gotham Park, to get some extra credit for their english class. The play is completely dull and Tim spots two young men fighting over the trees in the dark. He slips away from his friends, who are arguing about the play, and stops the fight. The aggressor draws a gun but Tim disarms him and tells the guy to go away. Tim drops the gun into a trash can and suddenly Helena Bertinelli appears to warn Tim about being wandering too close to her students.

Tim knows that the encounter could have ended up in Helena discovering Tim's secret identity. He tries to sneak back to his friends but he catches a glimpse of a car with three men inside armed with heavy weapons and with masks. Tim deduces that they are waiting for the play to finish to mug all the people. Tim starts looking for a payphone to dial 911 but he comes across with his friends, who stop Tim for a little while. Tim then knows that it is already too late to call the police so he goes to the Redbird and takes his Robin suit.

Robin sees the three thugs getting out of the car and jumps on them. The thugs start shooting at him and they catch everyone's attention. Robin uses some batarangs to disarm two of them. The crowd then starts to beat the two unharmed thugs. The third thug goes to hide in a nearby mobile restroom. Robin knocks the cabin down and the thug comes out of it. He tries to escape at plain sight and Robin can't risk being seen by Helena Bertinelli because she might guess his secret identity, or Ariana might do the same. Luckly Helena appears and knocks the thug without the need to dress up as Huntress. Tim changes his clothes back and decides that it is time for him and his friends to leave.

When they are leaving Helena calls Tim and tells him that she knows who he is and that his outfit let her know all she needed. Tim thinks that she is talking about his Robin persona but then she tells Tim that she recognized him because of his school jacket as the boy behind the trees at the beginning of the story. Tim is relieved and Ariana is jealous and curious of knowing how Tim knew a woman that beautiful.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #35
issues.synopsis: Even though Gotham is buried under mountains of snow, crime never sleeps. Robin takes out a group of drive-by shooters on snowmobile. Spoiler arrives as he finishes with the group. Robin tries to take her home but the pair notice a break-in crew at an electronics store. Together, they stop most of the burglars but Robin and a crook wielding a chainsaw fall through the roof into the store. The crook chases Robin and Spoiler with his chainsaw and accidentally cuts through several of the roof's support pillars. The added weight of the snow quickly causes the roof to collapse trapping Robin, Spoiler, and the crook. Meanwhile, Toyman escapes from prison by skiing over a snowdrift and jumping the prison walls. Back in the store, Robin begins digging for the buried robber. Spoiler decides to leave him to his fate but Robin convinces her that isn't the way he or Batman operates. As they dig, they uncover a mother and child who took refuge from the snow in the store. The chainsaw crook once again attacks Robin but is quickly knocked out. Robin and Spoiler eventually manage to dig everyone out and discover the sun is once again shining and the snow is finally given the chance to melt.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #36
issues.synopsis:
Robin pays a visit to Ulysses Hadrian Armstrong who has returned home from a short stint in a "youth study center". Robin just wants to give the General a casual warning and that he will have a watchful eye on him. After most of the Armstrong family left the house, Robin again enters Ulysses' room to search for clues about his next big plan. He is discovered by Ulysses' sister, but the little girl is eager to help Robin and leads the Boy Wonder to the "War Room" of her brother. Only a few minutes later he hears how Mrs. Armstrong returns and tells her husband that Ulysses was abducted by Toyman (although the truth is that Ulysses joined the Toyman by his own choice). Robin sees a problem here because the Toyman hates kids.

The next day Tim has a rough time at school because his girlfriend Ariana is ignoring him. And after school she does not answer Tim's phone calls. In the meantime Ulysses and Toyman implement a plan which will enable them to break into the house of the eccentric Mr. Crouch who is known for his huge collection of rare toys ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #37
issues.synopsis:
Robin once again "visits" the war room of the General with the help of his little sister Hillary. But again he comes up empty - there is no clue why Ulysses would ally himself with Toyman . After Robin returned to his Redbird he receives a call by Alfred . There is a fire call in the house of Phillip Crouch who happens to collect toys.

Robin immediately drives to the Crouch estate and gets right in the middle of Toyman, the General and the house owner himself. Ulysses is looking for a super rare action figure while Toyman wants his personal collection back after it was auctioned by the authorities. Now the partnership between Toyman and the little General is over, and Robin just tries to make sure nobody gets hurt during the fight over the toys. In the end its Mr. Crouch who has both criminals at gunpoint and Robin can wait safely outside until the police arrives. He is pretty sure that Ulysses will be free again soon ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #38
issues.synopsis:
Robin is in the Batcave and watches TV. He does not enjoy the reality detective show of one Roy Raymond, Jr. who also calls himself the Manstalker.

Next day in school starts with gym time. In the locker room Tim is shocked to see some rough bruises on the back of his friend Sebastian Ives . Tim asks about it, but his buddy reacts angrily and obviously does not want to discuss this topic further. At least Tim and Ariana get a little closer again. She also does not want to talk about why she shied away from Tim lately, but is happy that Tim seems to understand that.

After dawn, Robin goes on patrol in Gotham City . He interrupts an intrusion into an insurance company building which is orchestrated by a man named Slyfox . Robin fights himself through his gang members, but as he approaches Slyfox, suddenly the lights turn on and the Manstalker appears to arrest the criminals in front of his TV cameras ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #39
issues.synopsis:
Normally reality TV detective Roy Raymond, Jr. uses actors and extras to shoot the scenes in which he arrests the criminals he hunted down. But this time he chose to approach the real criminal in an attempt to increase the declining viewer rates of his show. But as Slyfox pulls a gun and shoots, the situation quickly gets out of hand not only for the Manstalker, but also for Robin . The Boy Wonder is not able to follow Slyfox because he has to take care of the camera tape which recorded him first. Despite Raymond Jr.'s protests Robin steals the tape before following the trail of Slyfox.

Using a special rolling device, the criminal fled through a canal system and Robin is lucky to be able to use one of these things as well. While the police arrest most of Slyfox's crew members, Roy Raymond Jr. leaves the scene quickly because he has a clue where to find Slyfox. At the exit of the canal Robin arrives a bit late and only sees the back lights of Slyfox's escape van. But the Manstalker is there too and Robin jumps onto the broadcast vehicle which follows the criminal. After a wild car chase Robin is finally able to stop Slyfox and prepare him for arrest. Roy Raymond Jr. is less happy because his cameraman was not able to film anything. He has no choice but to retake the arrest scene later ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #40
issues.synopsis: Spoiler ignores Robin 's request to stay off the streets, and takes on a street gang named the Ghost Dragons , who are attempting to expand their turf into the suburbs, all by herself. Meanwhile, Tim has taken the night off to try and have a calm, quiet evening alone with Ari , but ends up getting more than he bargained for when he finds what her idea of repairing their relationship is.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #41
issues.synopsis:
Vari Dzerchenko catches his niece Ariana and Tim Drake lip-locking on the couch. Because Ariana also is wearing sexy underwear, the uncle totally loses himself and Tim barely escapes before Mr. Dzerchenko is able to clobber him. In tears Ariana tries to explain to her uncle that Tim and her love each other and that Tim would never do anything to hurt her.

Looking for some distraction, Robin goes patrolling and immediately runs into Spoiler . She makes fun of him because she senses his "girl problems" and then she tells Robin about her fight with gang members of the Ghost Dragons . Robin does not like to hear that this dangerous gang is trying to move their business into the suburbs of Gotham. Him and Spoiler agree to meet the next night to do something about it.

Next night Robin picks Spoiler up with the Redbird and they drive to Fatso's gaming shop - the only lead Spoiler has on the Ghost Dragons. The lead is a good one, but both heroes run directly into a trap set by Lynx and the Ghost Dragons. During the fight half of the shop's interior is destroyed, but in the end Robin and Spoiler have to retreat because they are outnumbered.

Robin brings Stephanie home. The right thing would be to tell her once again that the hero business is too dangerous for her. But Robin also enjoys the time with her, so he agrees on meeting her again in a few nights ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #42
issues.synopsis: Someone is using the costume of Crocky the Crocodile, a famous character from a kids TV show, as a disguise to rob small stores. At first, it looks like Dexter Crabtree is behind the robberies - he once played the Crocky character in the TV show before getting fired about one year ago. But the actual criminal is Mr. Bingo who also produces a TV show for kids, but his ratings decreased ever since Crocky the Crocodile popped up on the TV scene. In the end, Robin and Shotgun Smith take care of Mr. Bingo ...

Other Characters: Cassie Josie (On a TV or computer screen) (Single appearance)

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #43
issues.synopsis:
Robin follows Sebastian Ives, his friend from high school, to finally find out what he keeps hidden from Tim and his other friends. But following someone on foot in the suburbs is not that easy and so Robin loses Ives after he got on a bus. So Tim comes home early and decides to call Stephanie Brown. Steph just got a letter with a weird riddle in it as the phone rings. Tim tells her that he wishes he had not met her as Robin because now he has to protect his secret identity.

The next day in school Tim finds out that Ariana transferred to a girl school - obviously her father does not want to take any chances after the recent incident with her and Tim. In the evening Tim once again follows Sebastian - this time using the Redbird. And he finally gets behind the secret of his friend. Sebastian just works in a mall, dressed in a rat costume to entertain kids. He is so embarrassed that he did not want to tell Tim or Callie about it.

Later, Tim drives Sebastian home before changing into Robin to visit Stephanie at her home. Because nobody's there, Robin breaks in and finds the weird letters Steph talked about on the phone. Tim has no problem solving the riddles. They lead him to buildings from an unfinished housing project which are scheduled to get demolished in the morning. Quickly Robin finds Spoiler who is tied to a chair. She tries to warn Tim, but its too late as the Baffler hits him to the ground from behind...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #44
issues.synopsis:
The Baffler , former associate of the Cluemaster, has Spoiler and Robin at his mercy. The two young heroes are tied up on the rooftop of an abandoned building which will be demolished by explosives shortly after sunrise. After the Baffler proudly told them how he had escaped the police shortly before his disciplinary hearing, he wants to leave the heroes to their fate. But the schlemiel stumbles, hits a pipe with his head and goes unconscious right in front of Spoiler and Robin. Robin dislocates one of his thumbs to free himself of the ropes tying him. Then he helps Spoiler and to her dismay, Robin wants to carry the Baffler out of the building as well. With the villain suddenly awakening again, this stunt gets even more difficult, but in the end everybody escapes the building before it collapses unter the explosion. Robin and Spoiler then knock Baffler out again and have the police take care of him. Now Tim once again needs to talk to Spoiler about their relationship. Actually he does not know if he is attracted to Spoiler or Stephanie, but as long as he has another girlfriend it does not matter anyway and both decide to leave it at that.

Tim returns home a little later where his father Jack is already waiting for him. He had a talk with Ariana's father and decides to ground his son!

Meanwhile, Ulysses Armstrong visits a weapons exhibition and becomes acquainted with Ali Ben Khadir , the leader of a small country, who is about his age and seems to be in need of some tactical advice ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #45
issues.synopsis:
Tim Drake was just told by his dad that he is grounded because of the stuff that happened at Ariana' house. Jack Drake thinks he gave Tim too much rope lately and intends to change that. Tim feels misunderstood because he did nothing wrong, but more important to him is that his father now also grounded Robin. At least he can watch some TV in his room, and the breaking story is a hostage situation in the city. Suddenly Dana , the girlfriend of his father, enters the room. She sensed that Jack overreacted and wants to listen what Tim has to say about. So Tim tells her how it was Ariana who wanted to take their relationship to the next step. Dana believes him and will try to ease the situation with Tim's dad. Tim imforms Alfred about the hostage news via phone, but Batman is not available to deal with it right now. After a failed call to the police Tim calls Huntress , but she is not at home. To get his mind off the news, Tim calls Stephanie Brown and is surprised to hear that Steph actually thinks about quitting the Spoiler gig. As Tim continues to watch TV news, his father enters. But Jack immediately notices that Tim does not actually listen to him, so he gets angry and takes the TV as he leaves his son's room.

Next morning Tim mows the lawn and gets a visit by Bruce. He tells Tim that Batman took care of the hostage situation, so Tim did the right thing by not escaping from home.

In the meantime, the General gets closer to his new friend Ali Ben Khadir and even proposes to accompany him into his country and advise him on some military decisions ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #46
issues.synopsis:
Batman and Robin deal with the fallout of Genesis in Gotham City . There is a massive crimewave as superheroes lose their powers, and people believe the apocalypse is happening. Batman and Robin take down an overweight military nut named Mackey who is shooting bullets indiscriminately at the street from a rooftop. Batman asks how Robin got out of the house while grounded, and Robin explains that he snuck out while his dad is on a business trip. Robin asks Batman what the point is of dealing with individual criminals while the world is ending. Batman explains that he is not in this fight because he knows he can win, he is in this fight no matter what. Batman tells Robin that he can't give in to that hopelessness, because he's better than that. Robin admits that the crisis is not the only thing making him feel fatigued. He's tired of living life as Robin, and tired of living life as Tim Drake. Batman suggests that he go home for the night. Robin gets into the Redbird so he can drive back to Drake Manor .

In another building, the False Face Society are selling heavy-duty weapons to Young El of the Trey Street Samurai. This deal is interrupted at gunpoint by sheriffs Cissy Chambers and Shotgun Smith . The criminals shoot their way out of the building and make it into the streets, where they split up in different cars. Cissy and Shotgun follow the False Facers. Robin sees them and decides to follow the Trey Street Samurai. Young El shoots at Robin and the gangbangers crash their car into a ditch.

Robin pursues on foot, and easily takes down Young El's partners with batarangs . Young El escapes into a condemned building, where Robin follows. Young El shoots the building up while trying to hit Robin, and causes the building to collapse around him. Young El is pinned under ceiling beams in the basement, with the water level rapidly rising around him. Robin tries to help pull the beams off. Young El threatens him with the gun to make sure he stays, but Robin throws the gun into the water. Robin is unable to lift the beams, but he hopes that the water level will lift them off of Young El. This means Young El will be submerged for several minutes and must use a rebreather. Robin notices that Young El has lost all traces of his gangster attitude, and it's clear that he's only a scared kid. Young El asks why Robin is helping him. Robin says that Young El has never taken death seriously, and Robin is helping him because he's always taken death seriously. Internally, Robin wonders if he even believes the words he's saying. Young El is submerged under water, but the beam shifts onto his lungs so he can't use the rebreather. Robin tries to manually kiss air into Young El's mouth, but Young El fights him and dies.

Robin returns to Cissy and Shotgun, who have the other thugs in custody. They ask where the third shooter is, and Robin explains that they'll need to have County Services drag Young El's body out when the rain clears up. Shotgun tells Robin not to beat himself up over this, because sometimes these things happen. You have to pick up and move on. Robin tells Shotgun that he's heard enough cheap words and false sentiments for one night, all of them coming from himself.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #47
issues.story: "Warchild, Part One: The Prepubescent and the Dead"
issues.synopsis:
It is the General 's dream come true as he has assumed command of the small army of Dhabar. Young ruler Ali Ben Khadir gave Ulysses this opportunity but quickly feels skeptical about the aggressive approach by the General and, thus, fears for the lives of his people.

Still grounded by his dad, Tim Drake watches TV in his room and cannot believe as he recognizes the face of Ulysses Armstrong in the news. Tim immediately sneaks out of the house and talks to Alfred about the situation in Dhabar and the General's involvement. Then he makes the decision to retrieve the General out of the country before the war gets out of hand. But to achieve this, Robin asks Nightwing for help. Dick agrees with Robin's plan and they "borrow" a prototype stealth aircraft from Waynetech to fly to the warzone. As they reach the location, Tim puts on a flight harness and jumps out of the airplane ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #48
issues.synopsis:
While Robin is observing the camp of the army commanded by the General , Tim's father Jack has called the police because his son whom he had grounded is nowhere to be found.

Meanwhile the tension between the General and Ali Ben Khadir reaches a breaking point. The young ruler is no longer fond of Ulysses' behavior and wants to release him from his command duties. But the General is prepared - he has hired four mercenaries which originally fought for the opponent and now shall help him become the new ruler of Dhabar. The General sends Deadline on a scouting mission, but the mercenary gets ambushed by Robin. Using Deadline's flying discs, Robin enters the battle zone with Nightwing providing aerial backup. As Robin gets near the General, Ali Ben Khadir already has his former commander subdued and orders to arrest him. Robin thinks that the General deserves the coming non-lethal punishment and decides to leave the country without him.

Surprisingly, Robin does not want to return to Gotham. He feels spiritually lost and therefore Dick drops him off in France before flying back to the USA ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #49
issues.synopsis:
Robin has returned to Paris where he first learned martial arts. But his master, Rahul Lama, is dead and so Tim visits another dojo which is led by the Master of the Iron Hand . Tim sneaks into the martial arts school and sees the familiar face of Shen Chi who gets thrown out of the dojo for his bad behavior.

While Jack Drake speaks to the police about his missing son, Tim starts his practices and gets beaten up pretty good by the assistant trainers of the Master of the Iron Hand.

After waking up from nightmare featuring Young El, Tim skulks through the dojo and catches Shen Chi who wanted to steal books from the Master. Tim not only defeats Shen Chi and hands him over to the Master, but he also impresses another student - a young lady named Dava Sborsc ...

Other Characters: Master of the Iron Hand (First appearance)

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #50
issues.synopsis:
King Snake and General Tvorakovich have a rather fierce discussion regarding a failed weapons deal. King Snake suggests another delivery and "convinces" the General to pay him accordingly.

In the dojo of the Master of the Iron Hand , Robin is sparring with Dava Sborsc and she actually gets the better of him. Dava tells Tim that she seeks to learn every single strike technique existing and after finishing the "Whispering Hand" of the Iron Master only the "Leopard Blow" is left. Tim knows all too well that only Lady Shiva could teach Dava that move.

The next day Dava masters the "Whispering Hand" and, thus, wants to travel back to her home country Transbelvia immediately to continue the fight against General Tvorakovich and his troops. Robin does not understand how Dava's involvement could make any difference in such a war.

Later, the dojo is visited by Lady Shiva. She was hired to find a killer and is looking for master of single-blow techniques. But she is not welcome here because she already had killed the brother of the Iron Master. While Robin wants to find a way to warn Dava, Lady Shiva battles the Iron Master who actually has no legs. Of course, Lady Shiva defeats him, but Robin has already left to find Dava.

In Gotham City , Jack Drake visits Wayne Manor to talk with Bruce Wayne about his missing son. There is nothing Bruce can do about that at the moment, but he realizes what a burden his sidekick has to carry to hide his secret identity from his father. As Batman is patrolling the city later at night, he is confronted by Spoiler who also wants to know what happened to Robin. Of course, she gets no satisfying answer from Batman.

After arriving in Transbelvia, Tim finds Dava rather quickly and tells her about Lady Shiva looking for her. But Dava only cares about revenge against General Tvorakovich. Although Robin still does not understand her intentions, he wants to accompany her. But will he be able to just watch her kill the General?

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #51
issues.synopsis: Originally, Robin was accompanying Dava Sborsc to protect her. But as both are facing two soldiers of General Tvorakovich's army, Dava uses superhuman quickness to beat them. But more soldiers await them as they try to get closer the General himself. As the odds are stacked against them, Dava kisses Robin and suddenly he possesses the same superhuman speed she does. Despite even some hand grenades exploding around them, the two teenagers defeat the soldiers. But then Robin and Dava are confronted by Lady Shiva . Robin immediately attacks and due to his inhuman quickness he hurts Lady Shiva so bad she actually might be dead. Dava does not care about that which makes Robin furious. But he has no time to further think about that as King Snake enters the stage ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #52

info.Cover Artists: Jason Johnson Terry Austin Dave Taylor

issues.synopsis:
King Snake witnesses as Robin kills Lady Shiva with his bare hands when he is under the influence of the aramilla drug that Dava gave him. King Snake threatens Robin and Dava with killing them with the army that is just behind him. Robin is worried about Lady Shiva and tells Dava to distract the military men and King Snake while he tries to resuscitate Lady Shiva. Robin performs CPR on Shiva while Dava does her best against Snake and his army.

At that moment just outside the shack, General Tvorakovich dies in an explosion that wasn't meant for him.

Robin gives up trying to bring Shiva back, but suddenly Shiva wakes up with renewed energy and completely ready for action. Robin realizes that his CPR didn't work but it was the aramilla that was passed to Shiva through his lips that brought her back. Shiva is now under the influence of aramilla and she starts a killing spree among King Snake's men. Dava is shot in the head but it is a superficial wound. Robin takes her out of the shack leaving Shiva and Snake in a duel to death. Robin and Dava are near the forest when they are spotted by Dava's army. They take her with them leaving Robin much more troubled than he was before but he is clear on what he needs to do.

Tim takes a plane to Gotham City and calls his father on his way home. Tim decides that it is time to let his father know all about Robin and his double life he is living. Just before arriving at Gotham's airport, the captain announces that the flight will be detoured and instead they will land in Bludhaven . Tim is curious to know why the sudden change and the answer comes to him as soon as he looks of the window of the plane: Gotham is completely destroyed and burning in flames.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #53

info.Cover Artists: Jason Johnson Danny Miki Bob LeRose Joshua Myers Dave Taylor

issues.synopsis:
Quakemaster holds Mackenzie Bock as a hostage when Renee Montoya , Harvey Bullock and Robin discover his hiding place. Quakemaster's henchmen point their guns to Bock and demand that the cops drop theirs. Robin talks to Quakemaster and dares him to call him by his name. Quakemaster refuses to say the words "Robin" and "Batman" and he tells his henchmen to kill them all. Mackenzie Bock uses his chair to knock his captors out and gives the opportunity for Bullock and Montoya to shoot them. Montoya and Bullock free Bock and they decide to search for Jolene Relazzo while Robin and Bock go to find Quakemaster. Bullock and Montoya find Relazzo and she is glad to see that someone came to rescue her. Robin and Bock find Quakemaster and discover that he is just a puppet controlled by Arnold Wesker, the Ventriloquist. When he finds himself cornered, Wesker drops Quakemaster and takes Scarface from a chest. Wesker attacks Robin and Bock with a gun and he runs away. Bock and Robin follow the madman across some electric lines. Wesker's henchmen try to stop them but are shocked by the high voltage of the lines. Wesker is getting away and Bock decides to use his gun to stop him. Robin is afraid that Bock might kill Wesker but when Bock shoots, the bullet hits right through Scarface's head. Wesker falls to the ground and asks for a doctor to care for Scarface while Bock and Robin catch up with him.

Batman finds a dog on the street that leads him to a place where many people are trapped. Batman does his best and risks his own life to save the people. All the people are saved and the ambulances arrive later to help them, while a hurt Batman overlooks the scene.

Nightwing arrives at Gotham City Hall in time to stop Wesker's henchmen from harming Mayor Grange and Commissioner Gordon . He struggles with them for a while but when there is just one of them remaining, the building starts to collapse and Nightwing manages to escape from the falling building saving one of the thug's life.

Oracle contacts Alfred at the remains of Wayne Manor to know what news is of their friends. Alfred tells her that they are done and that Quakemaster is in police custody.

Batman, Robin and Nightwing contemplate the devastation caused by the earthquake and they are just relieved that the worst part was over, at least for that moment.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #54

info.Cover Artists: Jason Johnson Danny Miki Bob LeRose Joshua Myers

issues.synopsis:
Tim Drake goes to Ari 's neighborhood looking for her, but he finds that the whole borough has been evacuated to the high school gym as a result of the earthquake and the National Guard has arrived to watch over the place. Tim returns home and finds some men outside his house. The men are supposed to be repairmen and Jack Drake has hired them to repair their house. Mr. Drake has paid in advance and the men leave telling them that they will come the next day to start working. Tim knows that his father has been scammed but he doesn't tell.

At night, Tim goes to the high school dressed as Robin to check on Ariana. When he arrives, he spies her and feels relieved to see her after such a long time. Robin is distracted when he hears Stephanie 's nearby. Robin uses a Batarang to attract Stephanie's attention and later they meet on the outside. Stephanie is glad to see Robin and she asks him if he can go to her house and get her Spoiler costume before any looters find out. Robin agrees reluctantly as he is aware of the presence of the Army in that area.

Robin manages to sneak from the soldiers guarding the outside and enters the Brown's house. Robin finds that it has been looted already but he hopes that the looters didn't take the costume. When he enters Stephanie's bedroom, he is caught by surprise by Arthur Brown , the Cluemaster. Brown is armed with a gun and has taken Spoiler's costume. He tells Robin that he had looted the place looking for a stash of money he had hidden in the house. Some soldiers enter the house as they noticed the lights of the house and Brown shoots at them. The soldiers answer with fire and force Brown and Robin to head to the outside. They land on a budget pool and struggle for the costume. When the pool break, the soldiers discover their location and shoot them. Brown looks for cover while Robin takes the costume and runs away. After some time, he reaches the Redbird and before he can go anywhere, he spots the men that tricked his father and their truck. Robin takes their money while they sleep and he deflate their wheels.

Robin returns to the high school and tells Stephanie that he has the costume, but he won't hand it to her in that moment. Robin then goes to take a last look to Ariana and then he heads home.

The next morning, he returns some of the money to his father and tells him that it was a refund from the repairmen. He sent the rest of the money to a quake relief fund. When Tim steps outside his home, he finds that Ariana is waiting for him and both of them go for a ride in the Redbird without noticing the Spoiler costume in the backseat.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #55
issues.story: " Brotherhood of the Fist , Part Three: Monkey Fist"
issues.synopsis:
Batman and Green Arrow survived the snow avalanche, but the blizzard like conditions are still threatening their lives. But Batman is able to "call" his monster truck so that him and Green Arrow can make their way to Gotham City .

Meanwhile, the Sensei of the Brotherhood of the Monkey Fist is hiring Deathstroke . The mercenary shall take care of Eddie Fyers who uses his guns to take down the martial arts experts of the Monkey Cult.

Robin and Green Arrow are out on the streets of Gotham looking for members of the Monkey Cult, but they only run into some less challenging enemies.

Batman visits Oracle who tells him that the Monkey Cult is attacking martial arts experts all over the globe. Batman would like to know more about her sources, but Oracle remains tight-lipped regarding that issue. After Batman left, Barbara contacts Black Canary who is on her way to the headquarters of the Monkey Cult. But Dinah does not tell her partner that she is accompanied by the Bronze Tiger .

A little later, Batman, Nightwing and Green Arrow find Eddie Fyers and Batman warns him about using those guns again. Fyers tells the heroes that the Monkey Cults consists of different schools and disciplines - some of which are only mastered by very few members like the Silver Monkey.

Another special member of the Cult is the female called Paper Monkey . This woman is targeting Robin and willing to kill fellow monkey cult members if they get in her way ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #56
issues.synopsis:
Robin and Spoiler do some crime-fighting and defeat two burglars. Shortly after, Robin drops Stephanie at her house and he keeps asking himself how this "thing" with her can continue.

Next day at school, Tim has to watch how Josh Stanzland and a friend of his are threatening a younger school mate. Tim would like to interfere, but he does not want to compromise his secret identity by showing any of his skills.

In the evening, Tim has dinner with Ariana and her family. But immediately after leaving Ari, Tim again meets with Spoiler. Robin talks to her about not being able to share his private life with her. But surprisingly Stephanie is fine with being only with Robin and so they end up kissing each other.

Next day in school, Tim is prepared to end his relationship with Ari to be with Stephanie instead. But as they meet, its Ari who breaks up with Tim before he is able to say anything ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #57

info.Cover Artists: Rick Burchett Danny Miki Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis:
Robin and Spoiler have a date wearing their costumes. There is a sci-fi night at a cinema where most viewers wear costumes, so the two heroes are easily able to fit into the audience. They continue to have a great night.

Meanwhile at the police, the villain known as Dragoncat masks himself as a lawyer and speaks with three men accused of bank robbery. They were tutored by Cluemaster and Dragoncat , but that obviously did not work out in their favor as Dragoncat tries to kill all of them without the policemen noticing it. But one of the men survives and is able to tell the police about Cluemaster. Shotgun Smith immediately leaves with a group of officers and assault Cluemaster's hideout. Dragoncat is there by himself and furiously defends himself, but in the end Shotgun is able to break him.

A week later Robin visits Stephanie at her home. But her mood has changed as she confesses to him that she is pregnant ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #58
issues.synopsis:
Stephanie Brown tells Robin that she is approximately two months pregnant and intends to keep the baby. Robin is a little confused but promises to help her with anything she might need.

Later, Robin is in the batcave with Batman and they talk about the left escapees of Blackgate which also include the Cluemaster . While Batman uses the Redbird , Robin does his work in the cave and also talks with Oracle about the messed-up situation with his girlfriend.

Next day in school, two of Tim's friends tell him how they spotted a monster in an abandoned block of buildings last night. They intend to return after school so Tim tries to figure out a way to keep them away so he can investigate as Robin. When Robin goes to the condemned block, he finds that the boys had gone anyway and have now been kidnapped by one of Blackgate's escaped inmates, Steeljacket ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #59

info.Cover Artists: Staz Johnson Danny Miki Bob LeRose

issues.synopsis:
Robin has to fight Steeljacket who has kidnapped two of Tim's school mates. Steeljacket is no pushover, but Robin remembers that his opponent has a bird-like mutation and thus is able to break the hollow bones in Steeljacket's ankle. After that he is able to free his two buddies from school.

Later in the batcave, Tim calls Stephanie Brown via phone and she surprises him with her plea to accompany her to birthing classes.

Next day in school during sports class Tim is watching how Josh Stanzland again harasses another student. This time his "prey" is a boy named Philmont Denlinger. And again, Tim restrains his urge to interfere, but that was a fatefuil decision. Hours later he is called to the school's principal who tells Tim that Philmont was found dead. Tim cannot believe this and does not hesitate telling the principal that Stanzland and his buddy might be the prime suspects. But still, Tim now has to live with his decision of not helping a school mate because he wanted to protect his secret identity ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #60
issues.synopsis:
Robin is still feeling bad about the murder of his school mate Philmont which he might have been able to prevent. Robin believes that the two school bullies Josh Stanzland and Mark Meachum are responsible for the kill and, thus, starts looking for them after schoolis over. He knows that Stanz and Meachum live in a trailer park and so Robin places some motion-activated cameras there.

Later, Tim changes his looks a little bit to again adopt his alter ego Alvin Draper. This way he is able to visit the pregnant Stephanie Brown and take her to breathing classes.

Later that night, Robin is able to catch Stanz and Meachum. He beats them up pretty badly until they start to cry and beg for mercy because according to them they did not murder Philmont. To Robin they look pretty serious and he starts to believe them. Nonetheless, Robin makes sure the police picks them up. But as Shotgun Smith calls Tim in again as a witness, Tim clearly states to him that Stanz and Meachum are not the killers ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #61
issues.synopsis:
Nightwing is in Gotham City and teams up with Robin to stop some thugs who are stealing the last money from people who want to leave the city for good. Robin takes this opportunity to talk with Nightwing about the murder of Tim's school mate Philmont. Nightwing thinks Robin should continue to keep an eye on the former suspect Josh Stanzland .

Next day in school, Stanz and his friend Meachum actually thank Tim for his statement at the police. More worrying to Tim is the fact that Stephanie Brown is at school as well and Tim does not want her to recognize him. And after talking to Oracle , Tim visits Stephanie at home using his alter ego Alvin Draper. He is relieved that she obviously did not spot him at school.

In the evening, Robin once again visits the crime scene looking for possible clues. He finds a homeless man who regularly hangs out in the area. As Robin speaks with the man, both are being shot at by two masked men. But Robin is able to catch them and it is no big surprise for him that they are Stanz and Meachum. They obviously lied to him and tried to eliminate another potential witness of their murder of Philmont. A little later, Stanz and Meachum get arrested by Shotgun Smith . But in his heart, Robin will always share a part of their guilt ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #62
issues.synopsis:
Robin is visiting his girlfriend Stephanie Brown to tell her that he has to leave Gotham City . Stephanie thinks she will be able to handle the situation with her being pregnant and him not being around. They kiss each other and say goodbye.

The next day, Tim and his father Jack Drake fly to Keystone City where Dana Winters is aleady waiting for them. Having not much to do in the evening, Tim puts on his costume and patrols the streets of his new hometown. He immediately comes across a hostage situation in the courthouse.

Robin tries to enter the courthouse, but the police spots him and shoots at him. This leads to Robin crashing right into the hands of the criminals in the building. Before the situation gets out of hand, the Flash appears and quickly takes care of the criminals.

The following day, the Riddler is on a convict bus. He befriends Captain Boomerang and then both villains are able to escape ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #63

info.Cover Artists: David A. Williams Karl Story Zylonol

issues.synopsis:
Another evening in Keystone City and Robin is bored. He calls the Flash to do some patrolling together although Flash normally does not do that. Suddenly, hundreds of notes fall down from the sky. Every note has a riddle written on it and Robin immediately guesses that the Riddler is involved. Although the Flash is skeptical, Robin is right as Riddler and Captain Boomerang hijacked a zeppelin to distribute the riddle notes across Keystone City. Riddler's plan is to occupy the Flash with so many riddles that he will not have time to interfere in his actual activities.

Robin took as much notes as he could carry home. After talking with his dad Jack about adapting to the new life in Keystone City, Tim analyses the riddles. Later, he meets with Flash again and tells him about the clues he found and about their potential meaning. Robin finds out that Riddler had some boom boxes rigged with explosives. Robin and Flash find the location where the boxes are given away for free, but in the end its Superman who saves the day. The Riddler and Captain Boomerang used the diversion successfully, but Robin and Flash are still willing to bring them down ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #64
issues.story: "Stop Me If You've Heard This One"
issues.synopsis:
Robin and Flash continue to go after the Riddler . Captain Boomerang thinks him and Riddler already have made enough money, but Riddler wants more. While Flash is doing some active work, Robin calls Stephanie Brown . Steph surprises Tim by saying that she is considering keeping the baby after birth. Still, Robin promises her that he will be in Gotham City when the baby is ready to be delivered.

A little later, Robin sends Flash to a sportsbar, but then another riddle points towards a charity auction. This time Robin is not able to reach Flash, so he goes to the auction by himself. Finally, he finds Riddler and his partner Captain Boomerang there as they mug the guests. Riddler is surprised that Robin is in Keystone City . Robin has a tough time against two opponents, but then the Flash arrives in time and the villains get defeated. After they are lead away by the police, Robin hangs out a little bit at Flash's house. He tries to phone Stephanie, but when her mother Crystal Brown tells him that Steph is just being taken to the hospital, he asks Flash to carry him to Gotham as quickly as possible.

When Robin arrives, he disguises himself as a doctor's assistant and quietly tells Stephanie that he is here to support her as promised ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #65
issues.synopsis:
Tim Drake did sneak into the delivery room where Stephanie Brown was brought in. But he has to leave again because he neither is family nor the father of the baby. In the night, he returns to Stephanie's room dressed as Robin. Steph had a weird dream involving her baby and her evil father. She does not want to talk about the baby because it will get adopted by other parents anyway.

A little later, Tim calls his father Jack and once again apologizes for disappearing - this time back to Gotham City for a so called emergency. To Tim's surprise his father wants to come to Gotham Heights. Tim immediately runs to his family's house which is still on sale. He even has hidden some old clothes in the house.

Meanwhile, a situation develops at a hospital nearby. Three of the devilish looking henchmen of Nicholas Scratch arrive there because one of them has been shot ...

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #66
issues.synopsis:
Jack Drake and his girlfriend Dana Winters have arrived back from Keystone City and meet with Tim Drake in the family's house located in Gotham Heights. Although Tim's father is still disappointed in his son, he surprisingly decides they should move back to Gotham because he does not like Keystone City - and the same obviously goes for his son.

A few blocks a gun-toting trio of Nicholas Scratch 's henchmen has stormed the Blackburn Medical Center, demanding treatment from the doctors. Shotgun Smith and a SWAT Team is on site as well, but they have to be careful because the men with the devilish looking faces are armed with machine pistols.

To celebrate their decision, Tim, Jack and Dana go to a restaurant, but it becomes odd for Tim because his ex-girlfriend Ariana Dzerchenko works as a waitress there. Despite their past, she is happy that Tim will move back to Gotham. When Tim hears about the situation in the hospital, he uses his first chance to leave and change into Robin.

Meanwhile, Scratch's henchmen get the information from the doctors that all three of them will die because someone messed up their DNA. They openly confront the police, but when Shotgun and his men finally find them in the morgue, they are already beaten up. Looking at a batarang on the ground, Shotgun knows who helped him out here.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #67
issues.synopsis:
Robin and Nightwing are summoned by Batman to get return to Gotham City and help him retake the city. They use parts of the old Gotham aqueduct and sewer system to get into the city without being noticed by the security forces around it.

Meanwhile, Gearhead and Tommy Mangles form an unlikely alliance in the Gotham sewers and they are taking advantage of any refugee, scaring them off and stealing their supplies. Some rats are attracted by the noises they make and food they dropped. One of the rats goes back to Ratchatcher and the man knows that his little friend has discovered something.

As Robin and Nightwing approach the exit, Mangles and Gearhead notice their presence and attack them. Robin manages to fight them both and Nightwing knocks them to the waters below. Then they use an exit tunnel to reach the surface and meet with their allies .

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #68
issues.story: "War Beneath the Streets!, Part One: Rats!"
issues.synopsis:
Tommy Mangles and Gearhead are dragged by the water along the sewers and they end up in a different place from where they were before.

Outside in Gotham , Batman gives Robin a job: to find the source of the food that has been circulating in Gotham for the last few days.

In the sewers, the group of people that were displaced by Mangles and Gearhead venture again in the place where they stored canned food and other goods. They spot a rat and try to kill it, but in a few minutes they are surrounded by an army of rats and the vermin attack them and and they run away. The rats are commanded by The Ratcatcher .

Robin starts asking the people in Gotham for answers about the source of the food and goods but the information isn't really helpful.

Outside Gotham in the suburbs, Stephanie Brown arrives at her home after jogging and finds her mother Crystal cleaning up her bedroom and taking the maternity clothes to sell them. Stephanie is happy to finally return to her optimal physical condition but her joy is crushed when her mother finds her Spoiler costume and requests an explanation.

Back in Gotham, Robin finally discovers the gang that is auctioning the food and goods and he forces them to tell him where did they got the stuff. Robin learns about a storage cache down in the sewers that a group of people are selling to the outside and making profit of it. Robin ventures again in the sewers, without knowing what to expect.

Mangles and Gearhead are still wandering the sewers and after a lot of time, they realize they are lost.

Robin looks for any sign in the sewers but find nothing. Robin catches the sound of a voice coming from down of a tunnel. He goes to see who is it and discovers that it is the Ratcatcher. He has gathered a great group of rats in the storage vault and is planning to feed his animals with all that food and make them grow in numbers so that he can take the outside city and claim it for his own. Robin is listening to all of the madman's plan when he is surprised by a rat that bites him and makes him lose his balance and fall down to the ground. Ratcatcher is glad to see another source of food for his animals and Robin finds himself surrounded by hundreds of rats.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #69
issues.story: "War Beneath the Streets!, Part Two: Wolflings"
issues.synopsis:
Crystal Brown confronts her daughter Stephanie about the costume she found while arranging her clothes. Ms. Brown was worried that Stephanie is following in her father 's footsteps but Stephanie assured her that The Spoiler was one of the good guys. Steph told her mom about Spoiler and acknowledged that someone helped her a little bit, tacitly referring to Robin.

At that moment, Robin was in Gotham's sewers facing The Ratcatcher and an army of rats that had him surrounded. Robin tried to escape but there were too many rats and they caught up with the boy wonder and started to climb on him. When Robin was covered under a pile of rats he used a secret mechanism of his costume that generated a hundred thousand volt jolt and killed all the rats on top of him. Robin seized the chance to ran away from the place but Ratcatcher was even more determined to catch Robin for killing his pets and he sent the rest of the rats to follow Robin. The boy wonder dived in the sewer's running waters and the rats stopped their chase. Ratcatcher sent one rat to follow Robin and learn where was he going.

At Stephanie's place, she and her mother were chatting about Spoiler's feats and how she managed to keep the city clean from Cluemaster's schemes. However, Steph believed everything was going fine when suddenly her mother told her that she was forbidden to go out in the Spoiler costume ever again.

Elsewhere in the sewers of Gotham City , Gearhead and Tommy Mangles were still lost and checked on a map to know where to go next. After they left the place, Robin emerged from the water and walked right where the criminals were a few moments ago. Robin was feeling sick and was tired. He took some pills and medicines in hope that the rat's bites and the polluted water would not affect him. Robin was too tired and he fell asleep and after a few minutes someone grabbed him and carried him away from the place.

Robin was being tended in a bed and he saw his father ; Dana and Mrs. McIlvaine all inside his bedroom. He was still in his Robin costume and his father told him not to worry, as everybody knew his secret already. Mr. Drake then uncovered Tim and showed that his son was in underwear.

Robin woke up surrounded by people that were tending him but he was not in his bedroom, but instead he was still in the subway tunnels. The people around him were all kids and teenagers that were left behind in Gotham. They told him how they managed to survive and Robin recognized one of them as a student at his old high school. They knew that he was Batman's helper and decided to help Robin as best as they could. They formed a tribe-like society called the Wolflings.

The Ratcatcher was waiting for her rat to return and when the rat appeared, the madman told his pet to lead them to the place Robin was and he carried with him all the rats in the sewers.

The Wolflings asked Robin about his business in the sewers and he told them that he was doing something that Batman asked of him. The Wolflings were eager to help Batman and Robin, but the latter told them to stay out of it. However in his weakened state, Robin leaned back to his bed and one of the girls placed some ice in his head to lower the fever. Robin then asked them how did they managed to get ice in Gotham...

Tommy Mangles and Gearhead were still lost and gave up hope of finding their way back to the storage room. They kept walking and suddenly they found blocks of ice floating in the sewer's waters. Gearhead didn't like the ice and he asked Tommy to head back. Mangles wouldn't listen and then out of nowhere a voice speaked to them and before they realized who was it, they were frozen in a block of ice. They reached Mr. Freeze 's hideout and he didn't like it.

issues.title: Robin Vol 2 #70
issues.story: "War Beneath the Streets!, Part Three: The Survivors"
issues.synopsis:
Mister Freeze captures Tommy Mangles and Gearhead when they are wandering lost in Gotham sewers. Freeze asks Gearhead to tell him anything useful and Gearhead tells him about the storage room with canned food and other products.
